correctness.rationale: The zero pattern yields a tournament whose transitive subtournaments force triangular full-rank minors. At rank three, a seven-vertex equality case forces the Fano Steiner triple system; factorization through projective dimension two then gives a Fano realization whose final collinearity has determinant -2. Explicit rank-three constructions attain six over every field and seven in characteristic two.

originality.rationale: Classical work gives the quadratic upper bound and known rank-three lower constructions, including size seven in characteristic two. Searches across fooling-set, cross-free-matching, isolation-set, low-rank, tournament, and Fano terminology did not locate the exact rank-three maximum or the characteristic-two equality criterion. The claim remains to the best of our knowledge with a stated terminology risk.

value.rationale: The result closes the first nontrivial exact low-rank case of the fooling-set-versus-rank extremal problem, proves optimality of known rank-three constructions in their characteristic regimes, and identifies the Fano plane as the equality mechanism.
